meta.source: 261012_Sprintbox_AI_StrategyUpdate_Pitch_Planung_DE.pptx — theme 'Sprintbox AI – Three Levels' and slide 17 'Corporate ID · Logo-Varianten'
meta.units: Lengths are the deck's points x 4/3 (960x540pt slide = 1280x720px), rounded to whole px.

tokens.name: smaragd
tokens.usage: Brand colour «Smaragd». App-icon fill, primary buttons, active step badges, feature cards, eyebrows and accent text on light grounds (4.9:1 on papier). On dark grounds use it as a fill only, never as text (3.6:1).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Brand colour «Signal». The dot: in the logo, before eyebrows, as bullets and footnote markers. On dark grounds also eyebrow text (6.0:1 on tinte). On light grounds decorative only — 2.95:1 on papier, never text.

tokens.name: tinte
tokens.usage: Brand colour «Tinte». Dark slide and page ground, callout bars, logo plates on dark.

tokens.name: papier
tokens.usage: Brand colour «Papier». Light slide and page ground.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Theme accent 4. Subtitles and highlighted lines on tinte (12.0:1). On a smaragd fill only 3.3:1 — large or bold text only.

tokens.name: smaragd-tief
tokens.usage: Theme accent 3. Text on the mint tint (chips, success metrics): 7.1:1 on tint.

tokens.name: smaragd-nacht
tokens.usage: Theme accent 5. Reserve dark green from the theme palette; not used on the slides.

tokens.name: smaragd-dunkel
tokens.usage: Theme accent 6. Reserve dark green from the theme palette; not used on the slides.

tokens.usage: Cards and panels on bg.

tokens.name: divider
